title: reprodICU Native Static Schema
description: A single per-stay value read straight out of a reprodICU table (admission metadata, a precalculated severity score). Upstream's vars.json carries no `type` key, so the importer derives one from the entry's shape: `calculation` present -> derived_*, absent -> native_*; `dynamic: false` -> *_static, `dynamic` absent or true -> *_dynamic. The four reprodicu schemas encode that same rule, so a definition can only ever validate against the type it would be assigned.

path.description: The reprodICU table the value is read from (e.g. `patient_information`, or a path under `PRECALCULATED_CONCEPTS/`)

column.description: The column of `path` holding this variable's value

is_struct.description: Whether the column is a polars struct (value + metadata) rather than a plain value; the filter then addresses its fields with `.struct.field(...)`

filter.description: Polars predicate selecting this variable's rows, as an expression over `pl`

dynamic.description: What makes this variable static: one value per stay rather than a time series

unit.description: Unit of the extracted value, folded in from the source's units.json at import. Absent for dimensionless variables (scores, flags, categories)
